description: This file defines custom dataclasses for different frame types used in OpenAI Realtime API integration. Specifically, it includes frames indicating updates to realtime messages and function call results within a larger data processing or messaging framework.

classes.name: RealtimeMessagesUpdateFrame
classes.description: A data class representing an update to the realtime context messages, holding an instance of OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext.

classes.name: RealtimeFunctionCallResultFrame
classes.description: A data class encapsulating function call results for the realtime API, holding a FunctionCallResultFrame.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Default constructor for data classes; initializes instances with provided 'context' or 'result_frame'.
